title: Closed-Door Talks on City Lawsuits
summary:
*   An emergency meeting was called to address ongoing legal matters facing the city.
*   The sole item on the agenda was an executive session to discuss two pending lawsuits: "State of Texas v. City of Austin" and "United South Austin v. City of Austin."
*   Following the private discussion, no public actions or decisions were taken by the body.
